headword: {世渡|よわた}り{上手|じょうず}

definitions.gloss: socially adept; street-smart; good at getting along in life
definitions.explanation: skilled at navigating social situations and advancing in life through interpersonal savvy

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{世渡|よわた}り{上手|じょうず}だ。
{世渡|よわた}り{上手|じょうず}な{人|ひと}は{出世|しゅっせ}しやすい。
examples.english: Socially savvy people tend to advance in their careers.

examples.japanese: {不器用|ぶきよう}な{私|わたし}は{世渡|よわた}り{上手|じょうず}にはなれない。
examples.english: I'm too clumsy to ever be socially adept.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{世渡|よわた}り (getting along in the world) + {上手|じょうず} (skilled at)

USAGE:
- Can be admiring: "they know how to get ahead"
- Can be critical: "they're calculating" or "opportunistic"
- Implies knowing when to flatter, compromise, and network

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {世渡|よわた}り{上手|じょうず} ↔ {不器用|ぶきよう} (socially clumsy)
- {世渡|よわた}り{上手|じょうず} ↔ {世渡|よわた}り{下手|べた} (poor at social navigation)

COMMON PATTERNS:
~{上手|じょうず} pattern (skilled at ~):
- {話|はな}し{上手|じょうず} - good at speaking
- {聞|き}き{上手|じょうず} - good at listening
- {甘|あま}え{上手|じょうず} - good at acting spoiled

RELATED WORDS:
- {要領|ようりょう}がいい - efficient, knows the ropes
- {如才|じょさい}ない - tactful
- {八方美人|はっぽうびじん} - trying to please everyone

cross_references.label: being bad at getting along in the world
